propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tier wall-clock (361s setup vs 391s call) due to function-scoped rebar_repo running mkdir, git init, git config, init_repo, and git commit per test (306 ms, 58 spawns per test across 589 consumers)

Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker and copied (13.7x speedup: 306 ms -> 22.3 ms) requires four distinct fix-ups: worktree pointer rewrites, per-test REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR isolation, re-randomization of .env-id/.signing-key, and _pending_cache reset

Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op on copied repos (validates template still exists, leaves copy bound to template object store) and bare --git-common-dir guard cannot witness stale gitdir pointers; only git worktree list --porcelain check detects incomplete fixups

Template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context (pinned REBAR_ROOT, empty XDG_CONFIG_HOME, deleted REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/BRANCH/CONFIG, reset_config_cache on entry/exit) to prevent first-requester environment contamination under worksteal distribution
Deliberate coverage of from-scratch init_repo path preserved in test_init_idempotent_scratch.py and test_e4_init.py; template remains virgin (no tickets, no .rebar/) to avoid pre-warming side effects
Module-local conftest ambiguity under xdist (sys.modules['conftest'] bound to most-recently-imported) resolved by extracting shared helpers to uniquely-named tests/interfaces/_store_template.py
